sources.title: Buying a business
sources.evidence: Buyer must notify Tax Department before payment or possession, obtain own registration and withhold payment after a tax claim.

sources.title: Commercial Lease Guide
sources.evidence: Full and partial guaranties differ; entity rent liability may survive surrender; repayment clauses can defeat expected good-guy protection.

sources.title: Certificate of Occupancy
sources.evidence: Changes in use, exits or occupancy can require a new CO; agency approvals and violation clearance are part of completion.

sources.title: Food Service Establishment Permit
sources.evidence: Health permit does not replace other approvals; failed inspection requires correction; renewals need insurance proof and fine payment.

sources.title: Project Requirements: Asbestos
sources.evidence: Assessment, exemption or abatement documentation may be needed before DOB permits; known material disturbed by work must be addressed.

sources.title: Stop Work Order
sources.evidence: Full or partial orders restrict work; obtaining a permit alone does not rescind an order.

sources.title: Letter of No Objection or Completion
sources.evidence: Physical completion is not project close-out; sign-offs and complete filings are required; older buildings may need legal-use confirmation.

sources.title: Temporary Certificate of Occupancy
sources.evidence: Temporary occupancy depends on required sign-offs and unresolved issues; reoccupying after a qualifying vacancy may need a new TCO.

sources.title: Gas Authorization for Restaurants
sources.evidence: Licensed trades and FDNY/DOB inspections precede utility gas service for applicable cooking systems.

sources.title: Rangehood Fire-Suppression Systems
sources.evidence: Rearranging or removing cooking equipment can require changes to suppression plans; change of ownership is included in application guidance.

sources.title: Landmarked Storefronts
sources.evidence: Exterior work including signage, awnings, paint and sidewalk cafes is subject to LPC review at designated properties.

sources.title: Approval of Backflow Prevention Devices
sources.evidence: DEP approval precedes installation permit; testing and reporting recur; failure to install can lead to water shutoff.

sources.title: Food Establishment Pre-Operational Inspection Form
sources.evidence: Form requires operational equipment and hot/cold water; active food operations are ineligible for pre-operational inspection; gas must already work if used.

sources.title: Building and Remodeling FAQ
sources.evidence: Connection depends on contractor readiness, municipal certifications and deposits; certain nonstandard service requests or repeat inspections can add charges.

sources.title: Gas and Electric Service Step-by-Step Guide
sources.evidence: Contractor site readiness and utility inspections precede construction, final connection and meter turn-on.

sources.title: LPC Business Express
sources.evidence: Qualifying business applications receive specialized review; photographs and dimensioned drawings are needed; portal identifies eligibility.

sources.title: DOB Sign Guidance
sources.evidence: Current guidance describes accessory-sign assistance and moratorium provisions while retaining construction and zoning compliance.

sources.title: Project Requirements for Owner: Storefronts
sources.evidence: Permit-exempt work remains subject to other law and agency requirements; larger scopes need design professionals and filed plans.

sources.title: ADA Update: A Primer for Small Business
sources.evidence: Businesses must consider readily achievable barrier removal, keep accessible routes clear and offer available alternatives when removal is not readily achievable.

sources.title: Service Animals
sources.evidence: Public businesses generally admit service animals; staff cannot demand certification; limited permitted questions and exclusion conditions apply.

sources.title: Place of Assembly Certificate of Operation
sources.evidence: Assembly occupancy requires DOB approval; continuing permits pass to FDNY inspection and renewal.

sources.title: Noise from Bar, Club, or Restaurant
sources.evidence: Noise complaints can lead to measurements and enforcement; MEND NYC offers mediation for neighborhood disputes.

sources.title: Ventilation or Exhaust System Complaint
sources.evidence: Improperly installed exhaust and odors can be reported to DOB; exhaust may enter nearby residences.

sources.title: Commercial Tenant Harassment
sources.evidence: Law identifies coercive service interruptions, blocked access and unreasonable refusal to cooperate; lawful nonrenewal is excluded.

sources.title: Commercial Lease Assistance
sources.evidence: Program supports signing, amendment, renewal and termination issues; it does not provide litigation services.

sources.title: Employee and Patron Toilets
sources.evidence: Employees need facilities; qualifying older patron-toilet exemptions can end with permitted renovation; shared access cannot cross food work areas.

sources.title: Hospitality Environmental Compliance Guide
sources.evidence: Circulation equipment is measured from affected residences; inspection may briefly require shutdown; construction requires noise planning.

sources.title: Required Signs: Food Allergies and Intolerances
sources.evidence: Current guidance extends allergy communication to menus and platforms, requires worker-language signs, and states summons enforcement begins in January 2027.

sources.title: Cashless Ban: App-based Transaction Guidance
sources.evidence: A cafe cannot turn an on-premises purchase into an exempt internet transaction simply by requiring an app.

sources.title: The Inspection Process
sources.evidence: Inspections are unannounced; identification guidance, owner rights and tribunal help are provided.

sources.title: Restaurant CPR Rules
sources.evidence: On-site consumption requires resuscitation equipment and customer notice; choking poster must be displayed.

sources.title: Cashless Ban and Penny Rounding Advisory
sources.evidence: Cash cannot cost more; advisory permits specified customer-favorable cash rounding and requires disclosure; penny payments cannot simply be refused.
